messages.subject: rApache 1.1.17 Released
parts:
Thanks to Paul Gleichauf's persistence, we now have a new release of
rApache that should address the brew problem. It was a bone-headed
refactor bug I introduced in the last release. Get it here:

http://www.rapache.net/

Cheers,

Jeff
